annotations.title: Import profile from LinkedIn or resume

description: Fill in the user's Himalayas profile from their LinkedIn profile URL or their resume text. Runs in the background for a few minutes; get_my_profile shows the result. append_only adds what's missing and keeps what's there; replace_all overwrites the profile, so ask the user first. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

linkedin_url.description: Their LinkedIn profile URL, e.g. https://www.linkedin.com/in/name

resume_text.description: The full text of their resume

name: import_profile
